children: Finnish forest machine maker's Q3 net sales fell 7.4% yr/yr and amid weak demand
Operating profit for Jan-Sept dropped 39% yr/yr, pressured by lower invoicing and higher costs
Company kept 2026 profit guidance unchanged, expects operating profit on par with 2025
Ponsse sees 2026 operating profit on par with 2025 at €41.6 mln
Company says market uncertainty persists but invoicing potential remains for rest of yr
Ponsse to adjust factory capacity through year-end to match market conditions
WEAK DEMAND - Co said low construction and private consumption continued to affect demand in the forest industry, impacting customers and sales
LOWER INVOICING - Profitability was weighed down by lower-than-expected invoicing for new machines and maintenance services, per CEO Juho Nummela
COST PRESSURES - Rising cost levels and higher fuel prices weighed on profitability and customer investment decisions, according to management
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ponsse Oyj is €23.00, about 8.5% above its October 19 closing price of €21.20
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 18 three months ago
